profile_name: Move for charge ON — opt-in, not shipped
description:
Enables FIX_MOVE_FOR_CHARGE: a melee unit that plans to charge this turn (an ATTACK assignment from the melee chase gate making a Normal move, or a MOVE assignment with a planned charge from the phase plan) chooses where that Normal move ends by the charge it will leave. 11e 11.02 / 11.04: the unit declares, rolls 2D6 and may then select only enemy units within 12" and within the roll, measured base to base (errata FAQ under 02.02: modifiers count; errata 02.02.01: a charge roll is never more than 12), so the move is aimed by the edge gap of the closest pair of models, not by the centroids — priced as an option over the roll (per roll the best target in reach, so a spot within reach of two targets is worth more), each target on its nearest clean lane (no enemy base across the path 03.01, no non-target enemy within engagement range of the contact point 11.04, room for the base, no dense feature the keywords cannot cross 13.06), every proposal stopping just outside engagement range (09.05). With an objective it trades the odds against progress (at most MOVE_FOR_CHARGE_MAX_LOSS_INCHES given up against the straight objective move, never an extra turn, never lost control range or OC) and may drop a T7-23 steer that buys too little. Re-checked on the destinations the mover returns (the flag-off move is kept when the gain is lost). Never for an Advance (09.06) and never turns a Normal move into one; never for a unit the engine says cannot charge this turn. Free charge re-rolls are priced only with FIX_CHARGE_REROLL_ODDS on (left at its shipped 0 here). NOT the shipped default (ships at 0); this is the arm to load for the fire gate / paired A/B, and what tests/scenarios/sp/ai_move_for_charge.json loads. Fire tag: '[FIX_MOVE_FOR_CHARGE] charge spot mode= kind= target= old=+/

% new=+/

%'. Exam: tests/exams/mv07_stage_the_charge.json.
